correctness.rationale: Proved for all p,q>=3 and real a,b,t>0. Two clique difference eigenspaces plus the irreducible symmetric Jacobi quotient exhaust the spectrum. The quotient determinant evaluates at pa and qb to nonzero multiples of pa-qb, proving the exact resonance boundary. PBH injectivity gives the subset rule, while a four-vertex compact eigenvector proves the unique resonant obstruction. The count follows by binomial enumeration. The two packaged checkers replay the symbolic identities and 3136 modular finite-subset comparisons; all-range validity rests on the written proof.

value.rationale: A natural two-community control benchmark has a complete and explicit all-subset classification, independent of bridge conductance, with a tunable internal-eigenvalue resonance pa=qb. The polynomial differs from the already-known robust zero-forcing test in exactly one degree by a count (p-1)(q-1), and the compact four-vertex eigenmode explains why the difference disappears. The result is a structural full-family actuator-placement rule, not a routine weight renaming or arbitrary finite table; no unproved practical control-energy gains are asserted.
